entity_raw.definition_raw:
Whenever you summon your phantom, it is more powerful for a brief period of time.

Prerequisite(s): Phantom class feature.

Benefit(s): Whenever you summon your phantom, you can give it a +2 enhancement bonus to its Strength, Dexterity, or Charisma. This bonus lasts for 10 minutes after the summoning ritual is complete.
